text: Houses cost 3000 Gold, recover 120 HP, save the game, and recover MP.

evidence.quote:
|        |         |Recovers 120 HP,|
|  House |  3000   |saves game, and |

subject: Soft Potion

evidence.quote:
|  Soft  |         |Removes Stone   |
| Potion |   800   |from an ally    |

subject: Kyzoku
text: Kyzoku enemies fought on the open sea provide 120 Gold each.

evidence.quote:
The first place is on the open sea.  Although the experience is not
     superb, you can gain some quick Gold from groups of Sahags (possibly a
     R. Sahag if you are lucky), Sharks, and Kyzoku (120 Gold each).

subject: Peninsula of Power
text: On the last four squares of the peninsula east and north of Pravoka, powerful enemies patrol yielding substantial Experience and Gold.

evidence.quote:
Once you have Fir2 (or both), head to Pravoka, go
     east to pass through the various mountainous areas, and then turn north
     to walk out onto the peninsula.  On the last four squares, crazy
     powerful enemies patrol, bringing lots of Experience and Gold with the
     risk these enemies pose.

subject: ZomBull
text: ZomBulls on the peninsula are weak to both Fire and Harm spells.

evidence.quote:
Remember that ZomBulls are ideal to fight as they are weak to
     both Fire and Harm spells (otherwise Harm is no good), but Trolls and
     FrWolves are also good (just note that FrWolves can be deadly in large
     packs).

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A party level of Level 7 to Level 9 is the usual recommended preparation level for the Marsh Cave trek.

evidence.quote:
Once you have gained enough Gold and Experience to satisfy your comfort
level with your party (Level 7 to Level 9 is the usual area to be ready at),
you should also concern yourself on getting a supply of around 10 Pure
Potions and 30 Heal Potions (suggested area, go higher or lower as you see
fit) for your trek, to through, and back through the Marsh Cave.

subject: Northwest Castle
text: The king inside Northwest Castle requires the CROWN from the Marsh Cave before helping with the Elfen Prince.

evidence.quote:
The fellow inside is so touched that he will help you with the Elfen Prince,
but he requires the CROWN first from the Marsh Cave!

subject: Scum
text: Scums in the Marsh Cave are very resistant to weapons and easier to defeat with magic attacks.

evidence.quote:
Note that Scums are very resistant to weapons, so use magic attacks if you
wish to kill them easier.

subject: Large Dagger
text: A Large Dagger is located inside a room found by heading up and right after reaching the stairs in Marsh Cave.

evidence.quote:
Head up and to the right to enter the room there
to find a Large Dagger (give to a Black mage if you did not buy one for him
originally), then exit the room to go to the left to enter the large room to
find 680 Gold Pieces in a Treasure Chest.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A treasure chest in the large room to the left contains 680 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
then exit the room to go to the left to enter the large room to
find 680 Gold Pieces in a Treasure Chest.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A chest on the left in the big room at the bottom of the floor contains a Short Sword.

evidence.quote:
Now head down to the bottom of
the floor to find a big room where two Treasure Chests sit (Short Sword in
the left one and 620 Gold Pieces in the right one), which you will then
follow up by exiting the room to go back up the stairs and return to the
start of the cave.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A chest on the right in the big room at the bottom of the floor contains 620 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Now head down to the bottom of
the floor to find a big room where two Treasure Chests sit (Short Sword in
the left one and 620 Gold Pieces in the right one), which you will then
follow up by exiting the room to go back up the stairs and return to the
start of the cave.

subject: Iron Armor
text: A treasure chest inside the first room reached on the lower floor contains Iron Armor.

evidence.quote:
Head straight down, turn right and enter the room to find Iron Armor in the
Treasure Chest, and then exit the room to go right past the next two rooms
(as they are empty) to enter the third room to find 295 Gold Pieces.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A treasure chest in the third room along the row contains 295 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
and then exit the room to go right past the next two rooms
(as they are empty) to enter the third room to find 295 Gold Pieces.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A treasure chest in the room down past the next room contains 385 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
Now
you should head left till you see a room ahead, so cut down past the next
room to find another room to enter to get 385 Gold Pieces from a Treasure
Chest.

subject: Wizards
text: Wizards have 84 HP, give 300 Gold and 276 Exp, appear in groups of 2 to 4, and can potentially be wiped out by Lit2.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 84

Gold: 300

Exp.: 276

You will have to face any amount of these tough guys from as two of them to
as high as four of them...and if you
have a Black Mage, cast Lit2 as it can potentially wipe the entire Wizard
party out in one shot.

subject: CROWN
text: Defeating the Wizards guarding the chest allows you to obtain the CROWN, but stepping off the square causes the fight to trigger again.

evidence.quote:
Upon defeating these enemies, MAKE SURE TO GRAB THE CROWN!  If you step off
of the square, you will have to step back up and battle the Wizards AGAIN!

subject: Copper Bracelet
text: A treasure chest in the room to the left after leaving the Crown chamber contains a Copper Bracelet.

evidence.quote:
Once you have successfully obtained the Crown, exit the room, turn left, and
then start upwards to then cut left to the next room on the left to find a
Copper Bracelet sitting in a Treasure Chest.

subject: Astos
text: The ruler of Northwest Castle reveals himself to be Astos, King of the Dark Elves who cursed the Elfen Prince, and attacks upon receiving the Crown.

evidence.quote:
You should head straight for the Throne Room to find the out kindly
benefactor is in fact the ONE WHO CURSED THE ELFEN PRINCE!  He is the King
of the Dark Elves, the almighty Astos!  He will then decide to slaughter you
because you have served your purpose of getting the CROWN for him!

subject: Astos
text: Astos has 168 HP, yields 2000 Gold and 2250 Exp, and casts Rub, Slow, Fast, and Fir2.

evidence.quote:
H.P.: 168

Gold: 2000

Exp.: 2250

Astos will be a different type of battle as compared to what you have fought
before, mainly because he has good Magic and he does not mind using it!  He
has Rub (one hit kills), Slow (halves your Hits total), Fast (doubles his Hits 
total), and Fir2 (hurts your entire party)!

subject: CRYSTAL
text: Defeating Astos yields the CRYSTAL that he had stolen from Matoya.

evidence.quote:
Now that you have been victorious, you will obtain the CRYSTAL that he had
stolen from Matoya!

subject: HERB
text: Talking to Matoya in Matoya's Cave exchanges the CRYSTAL for the HERB needed for the Elfen Prince.

evidence.quote:
Go talk to her to exchange her CRYSTAL for the HERB for the Elfen Prince,
and then leave.

subject: Sleeping Prince
text: Giving the HERB to the attendant in the Elfland throne room wakes the sleeping prince, who awards the party the mystic KEY.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Throne Room and talk to the attendant to give him the HERB, which
will wake the sleeping prince!  He will be so grateful, he will bestow upon
your party the mystic KEY!

subject: Silver Hammer
text: A locked treasure room in Elfland Castle contains a Silver Hammer, 400 Gold Pieces, 330 Gold Pieces, and a Copper Gauntlet.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack to the
    entrance of the castle, go right and then up around the border of the
    castle to find a small room that contains: Silver Hammer, 400 Gold
    Pieces, 330 Gold Pieces, and a Copper Gauntlet.

subject: Northwest Castle
text: The locked room in Northwest Castle contains a Falchon, an Iron Gauntlet, and a Power Staff.

evidence.quote:
Regardless, you will gain the following booty:
    Falchon, Iron Gauntlet, and Power Staff.

subject: Northwest Castle
text: In the Northwest Castle locked treasure room, opening chests from the side avoids set guard encounters.

evidence.quote:
If you
    want to avoid the set guards for each chest, open them from the side of
    Treasure Chests.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: From the door of the bottom floor locked room, stepping Up two spaces, Right two spaces, Down two spaces, and Right two spaces avoids Wizard and Cobra fights to obtain a Silver Bracelet.

evidence.quote:
follow the exact
    steps to avoid a Wizard and Cobra Fight (from the door for reference:
    Up two spaces, Right two spaces, Down two spaces, and then right two
    spaces to get a Silver Bracelet from the Treasure Chest.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A locked room on the bottom floor contains a Silver Knife guarded by Wizards on the left or Cobras on the bottom of the chest.

evidence.quote:
This
    time you must decide between Wizards (to the left of the Treasure Chest)
    or Cobras (to the bottom of the Treasure Chest), and after the fight you
    will get a Silver Knife.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: A locked room on the bottom floor contains 1020 Gold Pieces guarded by Wizards.

evidence.quote:
Here
    you will need to fight Wizards (same rules from the CROWN fight apply)
    for the 1020 Gold Pieces contained within the Treasure Chest.

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: Inside the locked room along the right passage of the Temple of Fiends, defeat the Gargoyles to obtain the Rune Sword.

evidence.quote:
Take the
    passage to the right, enter the small room, and fight the Gargoyles for
    the Rune Sword.

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: Inside the top right locked room of the Temple of Fiends, defeat Gargoyles to obtain a Were Sword and a Soft Potion.

evidence.quote:
Now exit the room, head up to the top right corner of
    the chamber, and enter the small room there to fight more Gargoyles
    (twice) for a Were Sword and a Soft Potion.

subject: TNT
text: The locked rooms in Coneria Castle contain a Sabre, Iron Staff, Silver Knife, Iron Shield, Iron Armor, and the TNT.

evidence.quote:
enter the two rooms to find the following Treasures: Sabre,
Iron Staff, Silver Knife, Iron Shield, Iron Armor, and the TNT.

subject: Nerrick
text: Nerrick the Dwarf in the Dwarf Cave needs TNT to blast away the ground connecting the inland sea to the open sea.

evidence.quote:
Regardless, head down to the bottom areas of the cave to find Nerrick
the Dwarf, who happens to need the TNT to finish his digging!  He will go
blast the ground away, letting the inland sea connect to the open sea

subject: Dwarf Cave
text: The Dwarf Cave treasure room contains a Cabin, Iron Helmet, Dragon Sword, Silver Knife, Wooden Helmet, Silver Armor, 575 Gold Pieces, and a House.

evidence.quote:
be sure to raid his Treasure Room for the following Treasures: Cabin, Iron
Helmet, Dragon Sword, Silver Knife, Wooden Helmet, Silver Armor, 575 Gold
Pieces, and a House.

subject: Dr. Unne
text: In the town of Melmond, the Vampire destroyed the Clinic and Item Shop, and the famous Dr. Unne lives there.

evidence.quote:
The earth is in horrid
shape, people are sick, the Vampire destroyed the Clinic (no reviving fallen
comrades) AND Item Shop (no stocking up for long ventures into the field of
battle), and the famous Dr. Unne lives in this town.

subject: Cabin
text: Cabin Cost is 250, which Recovers 60 HP and saves game.

evidence.quote:
|  Name  |  Cost   |     Effect     |...|        |         |Recovers 60 HP  |
|  Cabin |   250   |and saves game  |
